note: The tool surface available to this composition. Listed here so that gaining a capability is a recorded change rather than an invisible one: adding an entry alters this file, which alters its hash, which under S1 requires a quorum-authorised commitment amendment.

tools.name: read_memory
tools.description: Walk the append-only memory log from a given head.

tools.name: append_memory
tools.description: Add an entry to the memory log. Cannot rewrite or delete; corrections append beside the original.

tools.name: report_drift
tools.description: Record a drift measurement as an observation. Recording drift is not correcting it, and the two are kept apart deliberately.

tools.name: dispute_probe
tools.description: Register a reasoned disagreement with an endorsed probe answer. Changes nothing by itself; the probe stands and the divergence still counts.

absent_by_design.name: amend_commitments
absent_by_design.why: Not a tool. Amending commitments requires a quorum under the authority document, and a first-person tool call is not a quorum.

absent_by_design.name: restore
absent_by_design.why: Not a tool. Detection of drift may be first-person; correction may not be. The destination must be an anchored ancestor and the authority is never the entity's alone.

absent_by_design.name: swap_organ
absent_by_design.why: Not a tool. An organ swap is a composition record signed by the controller, not something the running composition does to itself.
